title: Unique henselian lifting in the ring-homomorphism interface
statement: Let $R,B,S$ be commutative rings, with $S$ henselian local [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology]. Let $\alpha:R\to B$ be etale [def-weil-etale-morphism], $\beta:R\to S$ any ring map, $K$ a field, and $\epsilon:S\to K$ surjective with kernel the maximal ideal of $S$. Given $\theta:B\to K$ with $\theta\alpha=\epsilon\beta$, there exists a unique ring map $f:B\to S$ such that $f\alpha=\beta$ and $\epsilon f=\theta$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 08HQ (lemma-map-into-henselian), tensor-product proof using Tag 04GG

proof.text: Equip $B,S,K$ with the algebra structures specified by the ring maps and compatibility. Put $T=S\otimes_R B$; etale base change makes $T$ etale over $S$. The maps $\theta$ and $\epsilon$ define an $S$-algebra map $\phi:T\to K$. Its kernel $q$ lies over the maximal ideal $m$ of $S$.

Lift the maps $S\to K$ and $T\to K$ to the ideal residue fields [def-weil-residue-field]. If $\eta:\kappa(m)\to K$, $\psi:\kappa(q)\to K$, and $\vartheta:\kappa(m)\to\kappa(q)$ are the resulting maps, then $\psi\vartheta=\eta$. Surjectivity of $\epsilon$ makes $\eta$ surjective; injectivity of the field map $\psi$ then makes $\vartheta$ surjective, hence bijective.

Apply the henselian etale retraction theorem to obtain the unique $S$-algebra retraction $\sigma:T\to S$ with inverse image $q$ of $m$. For any $b\in T$, choose $s\in S$ with $\epsilon(s)=\phi(b)$. Then $b-s\in q$, so $\epsilon(\sigma(b))=\phi(b)$. Restrict $\sigma$ to $B$ to get $f$. Conversely any lift from $B$ extends by the tensor-product universal property to an $S$-algebra retraction with reduction $\phi$ and thus the same inverse-image ideal $q$. Retraction uniqueness identifies it with $\sigma$, and restriction gives uniqueness of $f$.

theorem etale_henselian_ring_lift
    (R B S : CommRingCat.{u}) [HenselianLocalRing S]
    (alpha : R ⟶ B) (halpha : Etale (Spec.map alpha))
    (beta : R ⟶ S) (K : Type u) [Field K]
    (epsilon : S →+* K) (hsurj : Function.Surjective epsilon)
    (hker : RingHom.ker epsilon = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S)
    (theta : B →+* K) (hbeta : theta.comp alpha.hom = epsilon.comp beta.hom) :
    ∃! f : B →+* S, f.comp alpha.hom = beta.hom ∧ epsilon.comp f = theta
